judge.intro: About 3 minutes: 45 seconds gathering, 90 in the journal, 45 in Reveal. Cadet makes the tour forgiving. Ordinary GAME rules apply; no invented or skipped events.
judge.scramble: First: save a radio and seeds with Find supply and Hop to hatch. Deposit a full bag first. Rescue crew, then close the hatch. NASA flare and particle records supply the countdown; the shorter timer is a GAME rule.
judge.shelter: Read Sun Watch: WSA-Enlil triangles are predictions. Vote: shelter or work? Set tasks, build a water wall, then finish shifts. Ordinary GAME rules apply.
judge.ending: The crew outcome is GAME. Open Reveal to compare your choices with forecasts and recorded events.
judge.reveal: Scrub the timeline: circles are your calls, triangles forecasts, squares records. What’s real? is open for source IDs. Earth observations are not Moon dose measurements.

Earth records, lunar story. These near-E: Earth records, lunar story. These near-Earth observations drive a fictional Moon mission, not a measured lunar arrival forecast.
The countdown uses a retrospective flare: The countdown uses a retrospective flare-to-detection interval. It does not prove how much warning astronauts would have had.
Kp describes magnetic activity at Earth,: Kp describes magnetic activity at Earth, not lunar dose. A CME arrival does not guarantee a solar-particle event.
Supply shielding is a GAME abstraction i: Supply shielding is a GAME abstraction inspired by mass shielding. Eating does not remove all that mass from a spacecraft; our formula does not certify safety.
Radiation is invisible. The storm shimme: Radiation is invisible. The storm shimmer is a symbolic warning. Hopping dust falls back down; it is not wind in a lunar atmosphere.
AM and PM label work shifts, not a 24-ho: AM and PM label work shifts, not a 24-hour lunar daylight cycle. Exposure points and recovery are GAME rules, not medical units.
